userStories.description: As a cam-cli maintainer, I need every pure-drift hunk between templates/ and the repo's installed copies reconciled with the winning side decided per hunk by the CAM-536 spec (1 template-wins, 10 repo-wins reconciliations), so that subagent-orchestrator.md and the three schemas become byte-identical pairs (making the orchestrator persona eligible for the symlink slice) and downstream projects stop receiving stale schemas, personas, and CLAUDE.md guidance.

US-001 | The repo-wins hunk (variadic `gship suggestions promote <fp> [<fp> ...]` + the 2026-07-20 triage-policy paragraph) lands verbatim in the template copy. Species: CHANGE-DETECTION. Oracle (the empty-anchor guard is mandatory: with a typo'd anchor both sides are empty and a bare diff returns 0, a false green):
H1='/pending entries), `gship suggestions promote/,/^6\. `git status`/'
W=$(git show main:.claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md | sed -n "${H1}p")
[ -n "$W" ] || { echo "ORACLE BROKEN: anchor matched nothing on the winning side"; exit 2; }
printf '%s\n' "$W" | diff - <(sed -n "${H1}p" templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md)

US-001 | Every non-blank line of the generic `scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md` sections is present VERBATIM in the template, with the exclusion taken at PARAGRAPH granularity, never at line granularity. Evidence-fidelity oracle, not token-presence: the comparand is the live line set read out of main, so replacing a quoted claim with plausible invented prose makes that line missing and turns it red. Species: CHANGE-DETECTION (fidelity-grade). Oracle:
M=$({ git show main:scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md | sed -n '/^## Knowledge-Layer Routing$/,/^## Cross-Repo PRDs/p'
      git show main:scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md | sed -n '/^## Release Conventions$/,$p' | awk 'BEGIN{RS="";ORS="\n\n"} !/computeNextVersion|classifyBump|recovery-runbook/'
      git show main:scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md | grep -F -e '- **Test quality**:'; } | grep -vE '^[[:space:]]*$' | grep -vF -e 'ADR-0059' -e 'lessons.archive.md')
[ -n "$M" ] || { echo "ORACLE BROKEN: derivation produced zero lines"; exit 2; }
printf '%s\n' "$M" | grep -Fxvf templates/scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md && exit 1
exit 0
WHY THE awk PARAGRAPH FILTER IS MANDATORY (audit finding F-04, reproduced): the previous line-granular form required two lines verbatim in the template that are the FIRST HALVES of sentences whose continuations a sibling criterion forbids there ("...a 1.0.0 graduation requires a manual operator edit of" -> `src/version.ts`, and "Recovery scenarios for misfired bumps, tag drift, re-tagging, and the manual" -> `docs/recovery-runbook.md`). Satisfying both criteria at once would ship TRUNCATED SENTENCES into the artifact every downstream project receives. The awk filter drops the whole 0.x-demotion and recovery-scenarios paragraphs as units, so no sentence can end mid-clause. `classifyBump` joins `computeNextVersion` in the repo-only token set for the same reason. The implementer must re-run this oracle and report the resulting line count; the pre-fix derivation produced 39 non-blank lines with 38 missing.

userStories.notes:
BINDING (from CAM-536 spec, gotcha 1): all 11 spec criteria above are carried VERBATIM from scripts/cam/issues/CAM-0536.json, already swept red/green on main 2026-08-11. Do NOT re-author, paraphrase, weaken, or substitute shorter equivalents. If a criterion seems wrong, surface it as a review finding; never silently soften it.

HUNK OWNERSHIP IS SPEC-DECIDED, NOT IMPLEMENTER-DECIDED: this slice lands exactly 1 TEMPLATE-WINS hunk (reviewer test-naming `it` restore) + 10 REPO-WINS/reconciliation hunks. Do not adjudicate any other divergence; the 28 OVERLAY-OWNED hunks belong to a later slice (CAM-534 US-003) and must NOT be touched here. None of the four overlay files (subagent-implementer/auditor/reviewer .md repo copies beyond the single `it` line, scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md repo copy) graduates to symlink; do not promise or attempt that.

Files touched: templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md (repo-wins variadic-promote/triage hunk), .claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md (template-wins boot item 12 + blocker paragraph + renumber 13 + '(7-13)'), templates/scripts/cam/handoff.schema.json (+3 derived properties), scripts/cam/issues.schema.json + scripts/cam/orch-handoff.schema.json (cam->gship, template wins), templates/scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md (~41 generic-section lines, paragraph-granular exclusions), templates/agents/subagent-implementer.md (Read-before-Write step 3), .gitignore (+.env.*.local), .claude/agents/subagent-reviewer.md (`describe`/`test`/`it`).

SHELL AUTHORING HAZARDS (measured while sweeping): (a) backticks inside sed anchors get command-substituted if an oracle is wrapped in bash -c "..."; run oracles as plain multi-line snippets or single-quoted throughout. (b) grep -F '- **Test quality**:' fails ('invalid option', pattern starts with -); use grep -F -e '...'.

Reviewer criterion: re-derive the line numbers after the other edits land rather than trusting 139; anchor on the backticked token list, not the line number.

CLAUDE.md fidelity criterion: re-run the derivation oracle and report the resulting non-blank line count in worker-report/handoff (pre-fix derivation: 39 lines, 38 missing). The awk paragraph filter is mandatory (audit finding F-04): dropping the 0.x-demotion and recovery-scenarios paragraphs as units prevents shipping truncated sentences downstream. Do not swap the invariance pin for the naive `! grep -q noUncheckedIndexedAccess` negative (jointly unsatisfiable: the template legitimately carries `<project's strict-mode flag, e.g. noUncheckedIndexedAccess>`), and do not widen the Project Stack sed range past `## Quality Gates`.

INVARIANCE: the template orchestrator must not be rewritten anywhere outside the promote/triage hunk (criterion 4's pin catches collateral edits). .gitignore parity confirmed non-perturbing: bash scripts/check-gitignore-parity.sh . reports PROBES=43 EXIT=0, probe set derives only from cam-*/scripts/cam/* names.

After editing templates/**, regenerate the embed (bun run embed-vendor) before committing; src/vendor/_generated.ts stays 1 line per template file (51 lines, templateFiles=27), so no scripts/file-size-budget.json raise is expected for this slice. Do NOT add .claude/commands/direct-fix.md to templates/ (would make _generated.ts 52 lines and trip the 51-line budget).

DIFF ALIGNMENT ARTIFACTS: after these hunks land, re-diffing the CLAUDE.md pair re-aligns two hunk pairs (33c46/34a48,49 Biome-paragraph vs --no-verify line; 59c75/60a77,115 Marking-a-bullet-resolved relocation). Do not read the new alignment as fresh divergence and do not 'fix' it.

SCOPE DECLARATION (state so a future reader does not 'fix' it): 'stack-agnostic base' is an ASPIRATION, not a currently-true invariant; 22 lines of SHARED non-divergent template text already name bun/tmux/cam-cli paths. The reconciliation boundary here is 'what differs', not 'stack-specific vs agnostic'; making the aspiration true is CAM-533 and is out of scope.

test/templates/orchestrator-boot.test.ts keeps both legs valid in this slice (pair becomes byte-identical, both legs agree after embed regen); collapsing it belongs to the symlink slice, not here.

Grep scripts/cam/patterns.md for 'templates', 'embed-vendor', and 'oracle' bullets before starting. Measurement provenance and full hunk classification live in scripts/cam/issues/CAM-0534.json and CAM-0530.json; do not re-litigate winners.
